diag.likely_cause: Localized areas with different texture or color caused by uneven processing during production.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil for immediate offline human review and inspect the preceding surface treatment or coating stage for uneven application.
diag.summary: Extensive, high-saliency dark patches with a clustered linear vertical distribution indicate severe uneven processing requiring a coil hold and line inspection.

diag.likely_cause: Scale material has rolled into the base metal during rolling, manifesting as scattered, fragmented dark particles and streaks across the surface.
diag.recommended_action: Check the descaling system and hot rolling mill scale-breaker stages, hold the coil for immediate human review due to low segmentation confidence.
diag.summary: Multiple large, fragmented rolled-in scale defects are scattered across the metal surface, requiring immediate coil hold and human verification.

diag.likely_cause: Localized corrosion creating deep, small pits scattered across the steel surface.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil for manual human verification due to low segmentation confidence, and inspect the pickling or rinse tanks for chemical imbalance.
diag.summary: Scattered medium-scale pits are detected across the surface with low saliency, requiring manual review.

diag.likely_cause: A crescent-shaped indentation resulting from cutting operations during the strip production process.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil and inspect the shearing/cutting unit on the strip production line.
diag.summary: A large, isolated crescent gap defect is present, caused by cutting during strip production.

diag.likely_cause: Friction between the steel surface and foreign objects during handling or rolling, producing multiple vertical bright scratches.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect guide rolls, tension stands, and handling equipment for trapped debris or burrs causing repetitive vertical scratching.
diag.summary: Multiple scattered vertical bright scratches of medium scale and saliency detected on the steel surface.

diag.likely_cause: Loose oxide scale particles have been pressed into the base metal during the rolling process, resulting in dark, fragmented embedded scale.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil and inspect the descaling and roughing mill water pressure settings to prevent further surface embedding.
diag.summary: Multiple fragmented dark scale particles are scattered across the metal surface, indicating embedded rolled-in scale.

diag.likely_cause: Continuous linear marks resulting from strip transition during coil welding.
diag.recommended_action: Check the welder alignment and flash trimmer settings at the entry section; no immediate coil hold required given low saliency and high confidence.
diag.summary: An isolated horizontal linear welding line defect is detected at low severity across the middle section.

diag.likely_cause: Zinc corrosion resulting from moisture exposure and high humidity during storage or transport, forming loose white-gray oxidation patches.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil, inspect downstream coiling and packaging dryness, and verify anti-corrosion oil application.
diag.summary: Multiple scattered patches of zinc corrosion and white rust are present across the surface, requiring an immediate production hold and humidity check.

diag.likely_cause: Continuous linear marks originating from coil welding during the strip transition.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect the strip transition area and verify welder alignment and parameters.
diag.summary: A medium-scale horizontal welding line defect is detected in the middle region.

diag.likely_cause: Exposed slag dragged into the steel surface during hot rolling, forming a dark, non-metallic irregular inclusion.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil locally and inspect the bottom-left region; check hot-rolling slag shielding practices.
diag.summary: A small, isolated dark slag inclusion is located diagonally at the bottom-left of the coil.

diag.likely_cause: Uneven drying resulting in low-contrast, irregularly shaped water spots across the surface.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect the drying section of the rinsing/cleaning line and hold the affected coil for surface review.
diag.summary: An extensive patch-like water spot defect caused by uneven drying was detected on the coil.

diag.likely_cause: Equipment malfunction resulting in unintended mechanical punching, creating an isolated circular hole.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil, inspect the punching press and trigger mechanisms for mechanical failure.
diag.summary: An isolated medium-scale punching defect caused by equipment malfunction requires an immediate check of the press tooling.

diag.likely_cause: Equipment malfunction causing unintended punching, resulting in a localized circular hole defect.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil and inspect the punching and stamping unit immediately.
diag.summary: High-saliency isolated punching defect detected on the right edge, indicating a mechanical press malfunction.

diag.likely_cause: Embedded oxide particles driven into the steel surface by damaged rollers during high-speed hot rolling, resulting in fixed dark linear marks.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect hot rolling work rolls for surface damage in the corresponding zone and quarantine the affected plate section.
diag.summary: A small isolated vertical linear dark mark caused by roller-embedded oxide particles is detected at the right edge.

diag.likely_cause: Severe local deformation induced by low carbon content, resulting in wrinkle-like surface folds and a rough texture.
diag.recommended_action: Conduct human verification of the affected coil zones and inspect the rolling mill deformation parameters due to low segmentation confidence.
diag.summary: Multiple scattered horizontal waist folding defects with low saliency and large scale require manual confirmation.

diag.likely_cause: Transverse fold marks resulting from localized yielding during the uncoiling process.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect the uncoiler tension and leveling rolls; place a temporary hold on the affected coil section.
diag.summary: Multiple scattered crease defects driven by localized yielding during uncoiling require tension check at the entry section.

diag.likely_cause: Zinc corrosion resulting from moisture exposure during storage or transport under humid conditions.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil for surface treatment and inspect downstream humidity and ventilation controls in the storage area.
diag.summary: Localized clusters of bright white rust patches require minor surface remediation and review of ambient humidity controls.

diag.likely_cause: A fine network of surface cracks resulting from uneven cooling or residual stress during processing.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil for human verification and inspect the cooling bed parameters.
diag.summary: Moderate-severity crazing with scattered medium-scale surface cracks requires human verification and review of the cooling stage.

diag.likely_cause: Flaky corrosion and uneven oxidized layers resulting from prolonged exposure of the steel surface.
diag.recommended_action: Route coil to pickling line for surface oxide removal and inspect surrounding strip.
diag.summary: A small, isolated pocket of secondary rust skin is present near the center-top of the strip.

diag.likely_cause: Lubricant contamination resulting in distinct circular or irregular oil stains on the strip surface.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil section, inspect the preceding lubrication and rolling application units, and clean the strip surface before downstream processing.
diag.summary: Clustered dark oil spot defects caused by lubricant contamination were detected near the center of the strip with high saliency.

diag.likely_cause: Uneven drying resulting in low-contrast, irregularly shaped water spots clustered across the surface.
diag.recommended_action: Route coil for surface cleaning and inspect the rinse-drying stage for airflow or temperature anomalies.
diag.summary: Moderate-severity water spots are clustered across the coil due to uneven drying in the finishing section.

diag.likely_cause: Repeating dents caused by slippage between the work rolls and the steel strip during the finishing process.
diag.recommended_action: Check finishing mill work roll condition and tension settings to prevent slippage.
diag.summary: Low-saliency clustered finishing roll printing defects detected at the bottom-center and center positions.

diag.likely_cause: Localized corrosion creating deep, small pits scattered across the steel surface.
diag.recommended_action: Hold coil for manual human verification of the pitted surface and inspect pickling/rinse stages.
diag.summary: Scattered medium-scale pits indicate localized corrosion, requiring manual verification and upstream rinse inspection.

diag.likely_cause: Flaky corrosion and uneven oxidized layers resulting from prolonged exposure of the steel surface.
diag.recommended_action: Route the affected coil for surface cleaning and descaling; verify protective packaging integrity.
diag.summary: An isolated, medium-scale secondary rust defect with flaky oxidation is detected near the center-left.

diag.likely_cause: Loose or scattered oxide scale marks caused by excessive temperature or uneven cooling in the thermal system.
diag.recommended_action: Verify segmentation via human inspection and check the temperature control and cooling uniformity at the hot strip mill.
diag.summary: Multiple scattered scale defects detected across the surface, requiring human verification and a review of the cooling system.

diag.likely_cause: Embedded oxide particles driven into the steel surface by damaged rollers during high-speed hot rolling, manifesting as a vertical linear mark.
diag.recommended_action: Isolate the affected coil section and inspect hot rolling work rolls for surface damage or pitting.
diag.summary: A medium-scale vertical linear oxide scale defect caused by damaged hot rolling rollers is present on the lower-right plate section.

diag.likely_cause: Continuous linear mark generated at the strip transition from coil welding.
diag.recommended_action: Inspect the welding station parameters and strip alignment; hold affected coil section for review.
diag.summary: A moderate severity welding line defect appears as an isolated horizontal linear mark from coil transition.

diag.likely_cause: Zinc corrosion resulting from moisture exposure during storage or transport, leading to loose white-gray patches.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil and inspect the anti-corrosion oil application and packaging seal at the temper mill or galvanizing exit.
diag.summary: Moderate vertical clustering of white rust defects indicates localized moisture exposure requiring packaging and anti-rust oil checks.

diag.likely_cause: A crescent-shaped indentation resulting from cutting operations during strip production.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the coil and inspect the shear and trimming section for blade alignment issues.
diag.summary: A large crescent gap defect was detected near the center-bottom region, requiring immediate shearing line verification.

diag.likely_cause: Wavy or banded surface patterns caused by uneven roll pressure or localized temperature variations during rolling.
diag.recommended_action: Hold the affected coil and inspect the upstream rolling mill work rolls for thermal crown and pressure distribution issues.
diag.summary: Extensive scattered silk spot defects are present across the coil surface, indicating widespread roll pressure or temperature anomalies.
